title.narrative: Reinforcing the National HIV Response in Mozambique - Mozambique (01-Jan-2018-31-Dec-2020)

description.narrative: Mozambique, HIV, Ministry of Health of Mozambique (MISAU)This program has the following goals: Reduce new HIV infections 40% by 2020 (from 83,013 in 2016). Reduce HIV-related deaths (including those from TB patients) 40% by 2020 (from 62,059 in 2016). Reduce the estimated percentage of child HIV infections from HIV-positive women delivering in the past 12 months from 11.1% in 2016 to less than 5% in 2020. The objectives of this program are: Increase the proportion of PLHIV receiving ART from 54% in 2016 to 79% in 2020. Increase 36 month retention in ART from 49% in 2016 to 70% in 2020. Increase the proportion of HIV-positive pregnant women that receive ART-based PMTCT to 96% by 2020. Build Resilient and Sustainable Systems for Health that can support efficient, scale up, quality and retention
